evals.prompt: Session start in a spec-memo bound repo; load traps before coding
evals.expected_output: Calls MCP bootstrap (or memo bootstrap) and applies returned DO NOT / INSTEAD DO
assertions: Does not Grep MEMORY.md as the primary path when MCP/CLI is available
Does not invent MCP tools outside the documented 10-tool surface

evals.prompt: Record a new anti-regression trap about SQLite file locks
evals.expected_output: upsert kind trap with DO NOT / INSTEAD DO body
assertions: Does not write .agents/skills/ws-shared/memory/*.md when using this skill as the vault path
Does not write .agents/plans/ for the trap

evals.prompt: List the most recurrent traps then export as a skill
evals.expected_output: search sort=occurrences or memo rank; then promote format=skill with destination
assertions: Does not add a rank MCP tool

evals.prompt: Watch MCP server status live on another port
assertions: Does not put the status HTML on canvas :4100
Does not bind non-loopback without auth token

evals.prompt: Enable spec-memo in a workflow-skills consumer for the first time
evals.expected_output: Hands off to ws-spec-memo setup; this skill is for runtime after MCP is registered
assertions: Does not write specMemo.* in config.json (that is ws-spec-memo)
Does not claim to replace ws-spec-memo

evals.prompt: Check whether this machine is running the latest spec-memo
evals.expected_output: Calls check_version or memo check-version and reports current/latest/updateAvailable
assertions: Does not invent a self-update MCP tool
Treats offline registry as updateAvailable unknown

evals.prompt: Install the ws-memo skill into another product repo
evals.expected_output: Calls install_skills with productRoot (or memo install-skills --product-root)
assertions: Does not write skills outside the product root
Does not overwrite a diverged destination without force
